limitations: Sentinel-2 TCI spatial resolution is 10 m; exported display pixels are resampled and do not add spatial detail.
The scene and crop support broad water/green/urban-structure checks, not building-floor or statutory-boundary claims.
The three anchors are low-confidence public location references, not official focus-area polygons, redlines, tenure records or partner commitments.
All submitted geometry remains provisional until official boundary, control-plan, tenure, survey and professional inputs are available.
